{{Quote|The target's a Republic noble, name of Altaca. He got captured during an Imperial raid, brought back here and sold into slavery by mistake.|[[Crysta Markon]]|<ref name="TOR:AMT" />}}
'''Altaca''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Noble/Legends|nobleman]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] who lived during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|My darling... my lovely Altaca. Wouldn't you rather stay here with me than run home to your pathetic Republic family?''"<br />"''What? Of course not! You treat me like a pet, and this planet is disgusting.|[[Dak-Ah]] and Altaca|<ref name="TOR:AMT" />}}
In [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="TOR_dates">{{TOR_dates|1}}</ref> [[Lord/Legends|Lord]]<ref name="TOR:Atoa" /> Altaca was captured by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]] and was mistakenly sold into [[Slavery/Legends|slavery]] instead of ransomed as nobles usually were. He and his fellow slaves were building the [[Unfinished colossus]] when he was rescued and taken [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoner]] by [[Lady/Legends|Lady]] [[Dak-Ah]]. He was convinced by the Imperial that he had no way offworld and that his family would forget about him. Opposites attract and the pair fell in love, though Dak-Ah told him to pretend that he's her brother in public. His [[Altaca family|family]] attempted to recover him alive by placing a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] on him as part of the [[Great Hunt (competition)|Great Hunt]].<ref name="TOR:AMT" />

During the [[Dromund Kaas rebellion]], Altaca's [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]] was recovered by a [[Hunter (individual)|participant]] of this competition who followed his traces to the [[Nexus Room]] Cantina. The bounty hunter encountered Altaca and Lady Dak-Ah together. When confronted, the hunter revealed that Altaca's family wanted him back. This caused Altaca to become upset at Dak-Ah's deception. After Lady Dak-Ah expressed displeasure at the idea of losing Altaca to someone else, she asked the hunter to [[Death/Legends|kill]] him, explaining that his family would likely pay less for his body, but that she would compensate the rest of the payment.<ref name="TOR:AMT" />

{{GameDS}}
The Hunter refused to make a deal with Lady Dak-Ah and killed her before capturing Altaca.<ref name="TOR:AMT" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
The player has two alternatives in the scenario where they confront Altaca. They can either accept Lady Dak-Ah's deal and kill Altaca instead, or simply take Altaca alive without killing either one.<ref name="TOR:AMT" />
